{"tool":"python","code":"from openpyxl.styles import Alignment
ws = wb['result']
align = Alignment(horizontal='left')
main_range = "'main sheet'!$A$2:$E$12"
for r in range(2, 13):
    v5 = f"VLOOKUP($A{r},{main_range},5,0)"
    cond = f'OR({v5}="Branch Manager",{v5}="Branch Credit Manager")'
    ws[f"B{r}"] = f'=IFERROR(IF({cond},{v5},"N/A"),"N/A")'
    ws[f"C{r}"] = f'=IFERROR(IF({cond},VLOOKUP($A{r},{main_range},3,0),"N/A"),"N/A")'
    ws[f"D{r}"] = f'=IFERROR(IF({cond},VLOOKUP($A{r},{main_range},4,0),"N/A"),"N/A")'
    for col in 'BCD':
        ws[f"{col}{r}"].alignment = align
for r in range(2, 13):
    ws[f"A{r}"].alignment = align
print('ok')
"}
